The Hanseatic League, also known as the Hanse, was a commercial and defensive confederation of merchant guilds and market towns in Northwestern and Central Europe. It dominated maritime trade in the Baltic Sea, North Sea, and parts of the Atlantic Ocean during the Late Middle Ages and early modern period. The League was founded in the late 12th century by north German towns, and it grew rapidly in the following century.
